_comment: Transcribed from the in-game customisation screens, captured 2026-08-06 (Steam captures 20260806011221-011900 and 023313-023457). Point cost is the number on the tile; every weapon has 100 points to spend across all slots. Split out of the combined Magazines page on 2026-08-06 so patch lines naming this one specifically have somewhere to land.
name: Extended Fast Mag

description.text: Extended magazine with mag pull for faster reloads. Increases capacity at the cost of weapon draw speed and movement speed while aiming down sights (ADS).
